regions.story_context: In a quiet village in Luzon, warriors train in secret, preserving the way of the rattan.
In the highlands, strength is tested in fair combat. Buno is respect, balance, and honor.
From makeshift rings in the barangays rise champions. Grit, heart, and never giving up.
Sikaran was born from freedom and resilience. Warriors honed their kicks to protect their people.
On coastal shores, every kick honors the players who made the Philippines a Sepak Takraw powerhouse.
